node.label: Latin America & Venezuela
node.summary: Elections and politics in Brazil, Venezuela and other Latin American states.

facts.text: Brazil's **Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva** won a **fourth** presidential term, beating Jair Bolsonaro-backed Flavio Bolsonaro **51.79% to 48.21%** in the runoff after trailing in the first round; Lula has backed the New Development Bank and BRICS local-currency trade, while Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro was reportedly taken to the US for trial in January 2026.
facts.plain: Brazil's Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won a fourth presidential term, beating Jair Bolsonaro-backed Flavio Bolsonaro 51.79% to 48.21% in the runoff after trailing in the first round; Lula has backed the New Development Bank and BRICS local-currency trade, while Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro was reportedly taken to the US for trial in January 2026.

facts.text: **Lula da Silva** won the runoff on **25 Oct**, the first Brazilian president to finish **second** in the first round (4 Oct) and still win; this is his **fourth** term (earlier 2003-2010 and 2023-26). Born **27 Oct 1945** in **Pernambuco**; a metalworker and union leader, he co-founded the **Workers' Party (PT)** on **10 Feb 1980**. Rival **Flavio Bolsonaro** fled to Florida, claiming persecution.

facts.text: Brazil quiz: Lula's **Workers' Party (PT)** was founded in **1980**; **Operation Car Wash** was the anti-corruption probe; Lula's ballot number is **13**; Bolsonaro supporters stormed Congress and the Supreme Court after the 2022 election.
